\]
attained by selecting policy one exactly when \(X_1/\sigma_1^2-X_2/\sigma_2^2\geq0\).  Selecting the larger coordinate instead has worst risk \(\kappa\sqrt{v_1/r_1+v_2/r_2}\), and it is all-rule minimax if and only if \(v_1/r_1=v_2/r_2\). \]

Equivalently the infimum is over location-invariant selectors \(\delta(x+c\mathbf 1_A)=\delta(x)\), hence over selectors based on \(D_AX\sim N(D_Ah,\Omega_A)\).  For \(M<\infty\), \(G_{A,M}(v_A,r_A)\) is the same invariant-selector game with \(\lVert[h]\rVert_A\leq M\). Let \(A\) be finite with \(d=|A|\geq2\), let \(v_i,r_i>0\), and write
\[
\Sigma=\Sigma(v_A,r_A)=\operatorname{diag}(\sigma_i^2:i\in A),
\qquad \sigma_i^2=v_i/r_i,
\qquad \bar\sigma=\max_{i\in A}\sigma_i.
\]
For every nonempty \(S\subseteq A\), let \(G_{S,M}(v_S,r_S)\) denote the compact quotient game obtained by restricting the Gaussian face-game definition to \(S\), with the singleton value set equal to zero.  Fix \(0<\lambda<1\), \(T>0\), and for every nonempty \(S\subseteq A\) choose \(M_S\) satisfying
\[
M_S\geq2\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,T\sqrt{|S|-1},
\qquad
H_{\lambda,T}(v_A,r_A)=\max_{\varnothing\ne S\subseteq A}G_{S,M_S}(v_S,r_S),
\qquad
a_\lambda=\sqrt{2/\lambda}\,\bar\sigma.
\]
If, for each \(S\), a represented invariant selector has risk at most \(G_{S,M_S}(v_S,r_S)+\eta\) on its displayed compact quotient ball, then an explicit randomized invariant selector in the unbounded \(A\)-arm experiment satisfies
\[
H_{\lambda,T}(v_A,r_A)
\leq G_A(v_A,r_A)
\leq \sup_{h\in\mathbb R^A}\mathbb E_h\!\left[\max_{i\in A}h_i-h_{\delta(X)}\right]
\leq
(1-\lambda)^{-1/2}\{H_{\lambda,T}(v_A,r_A)+\eta\}
+\frac{2d^2a_\lambda}{\sqrt{2\pi}}
 \exp\!\left\{-\frac{T^2}{2a_\lambda^2}\right\}.
\]
The construction and bound hold uniformly on every compact cell of positive diagonal variances.  In particular, for every nonempty \(S\subseteq A\),
\[
G_S(v_S,r_S)\leq G_A(v_A,r_A).
\]

snapshot.stmt:
Let \(A=\operatorname*{arg\,max}_kU_k(P_0)\), with \(|A|\geq2\), and suppose every policy in \(A^c\) is separated below the tied active welfare.  For every representative \(h\in\mathbb R^A\), including its common-shift component, the path \(\bar P_{C,h}=\bar P_{C^{-1/2},h}\) satisfies \(Q^B_{\bar P_0,p}=Q^B_{P_0,p}\), \(dU_k(\bar P_{t,h})/dt|_{t=0}=h_k\), and
\[
\log\frac{d(Q^B_{\bar P_{C,h},p})^{\otimes C}}{d(Q^B_{P_0,p})^{\otimes C}}
=h^{\prime}\Delta_C^B-\frac12h^{\prime}I_Bh+o_{(Q^B_{P_0,p})^{\otimes C}}(1),
\qquad \Delta_C^B\Rightarrow N(0,I_B),
\]
with \(\dot\ell_k^B\in L^2_0(Q^B_{P_0,p})\) and \(I_B=\operatorname{diag}(q_k/\tau_k^2:k\in A)\).  Under \(\bar P_{C,h}\),
\[
\sqrt C\{\widetilde U_{C,A}-U_A(P_0)\}\Rightarrow
N\{h,\Sigma_{B,A}\}.
\]
For every measurable randomized rule sequence \(\delta_C\) and every \(M<\infty\),
\[
\liminf_{C\to\infty}\sup_{h\in\mathbb R^A:\ \lVert[h]\rVert_A\leq M}
\sqrt C\,\mathbb E_{(Q^B_{\bar P_{C,h},p})^{\otimes C}}
\left[\max_{k\in A}U_k(\bar P_{C,h})-U_{\delta_C}(\bar P_{C,h})\right]
\geq G_{A,M}(\tau_A^2,q_A).
\]
Moreover \(G_{A,M}\uparrow G_A\) as \(M\to\infty\).  The same lower bounds hold for rules observing the full Bernoulli experiment by nuisance deletion.

When \(K=2\) and \(A=\mathcal K\), the quotient statistic is \(X_1-X_2\), and for positive rates
\[
G_A(v_A,r_A)=\kappa\sqrt{\frac{v_1}{r_1}+\frac{v_2}{r_2}},
\]
attained by selecting policy one exactly when \(X_1-X_2\geq0\).  Consequently the optimized exact-count share is
\[
\alpha_1^\star=\frac{\sqrt{v_1}}{\sqrt{v_1}+\sqrt{v_2}}.
\]
For Bernoulli labels, \(t^\star\) minimizes \(F_v(t)\).  If \(B_{11}>B_{12}\) and \(B_{22}>B_{21}\), then \(t^\star=0\) exactly when
\[
\frac{v_1}{v_2}\leq\frac{(B_{22}-B_{21})B_{12}^2}{(B_{11}-B_{12})B_{22}^2},
\]
and \(t^\star=1\) exactly when
\[
\frac{v_1}{v_2}\geq\frac{(B_{22}-B_{21})B_{11}^2}{(B_{11}-B_{12})B_{21}^2};
\]
otherwise it is the unique interior value
\[
t^\star=
\frac{B_{22}\sqrt{v_1(B_{11}-B_{12})/[v_2(B_{22}-B_{21})]}-B_{12}}
{(B_{11}-B_{12})+(B_{22}-B_{21})\sqrt{v_1(B_{11}-B_{12})/[v_2(B_{22}-B_{21})]}}.
\]
For \(n=4\), \((\pi_1,\pi_2)=(1/4,1/2)\), and \(v_1=v_2\),
\[
B=\begin{pmatrix}27/64&1/4\\27/128&3/8\end{pmatrix},\qquad
t^\star=-80+\frac{288\sqrt{462}}{77}.
\]
Relative to optimized exact-count assignment, the exact regret ratio and cluster-count ratio are, respectively,
\[
\left(\frac{43}{54}+\frac{\sqrt{462}}{27}\right)^{1/2}
\quad\text{and}\quad
\frac{43}{54}+\frac{\sqrt{462}}{27}.
\]
They lie in \([1.26189430296,1.26189430298]\) and \([1.59237723185,1.59237723187]\), while \(t^\star\in[0.39383577842,0.39383577844]\).

defs.def:two-policy-allocation:
For \(K=2\), write \(p=(t,1-t)\), \(q_1(t)=B_{12}+(B_{11}-B_{12})t\), and \(q_2(t)=B_{22}-(B_{22}-B_{21})t\).  Define
\[
F_v(t)=\frac{v_1}{q_1(t)}+\frac{v_2}{q_2(t)},\qquad
t^\star=\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{0\leq t\leq1}F_v(t).
\]
This is the exact contrast-variance allocation map for the two-action quotient game.  Its exact-count counterpart minimizes \(v_1/\alpha_1+v_2/(1-\alpha_1)\) over \(0<\alpha_1<1\).

snapshot.stmt: For every tie face \(A\) with \(|A|\geq2\) and positive \(v_A\), define \(s_A(p)=\sum_{k\in A}(Bp)_k\), \(a_A(p)=(Bp)_A/s_A(p)\), and \(s_{A,\max}=\max_\ell\sum_{k\in A}B_{k\ell}\). Then \(G_A(v_A,(Bp)_A)=s_A(p)^{-1/2}G_A(v_A,a_A(p))\) and \[\frac{R_{B,A}^\star(v_A)}{R_{CR,A}^\star(v_A)}\geq s_{A,\max}^{-1/2}>1.\] Equality in this lower ratio holds exactly when there exists a Bernoulli optimizer \(p\) supported on columns attaining \(s_{A,\max}\) whose normalized active vector \(a_A(p)\) is exact-count optimal. Inactive coordinates may be zero and are never passed to \(G_A\).

defs.def:face-mechanism-values:
Using the lower-semicontinuous boundary value of \(G_A\), define
\[
R_{B,A}^\star(v_A)=\min_{p\in\Delta_K}G_A(v_A,(Bp)_A),\qquad
R_{CR,A}^\star(v_A)=\min_{a\in\Delta_A}G_A(v_A,a).
\]
Only the active coordinates are supplied to \(G_A\).  Positivity of every entry of \(B\) keeps \((Bp)_A\) in the positive orthant, whereas boundary coercivity makes every minimizer in the exact-count simplex belong to \(\Delta_A^\circ\); allocating mass to inactive exact-count policies is therefore excluded after the active face is selected.

defs.def:face-mechanism-values:

snapshot.stmt:
Let \(A=\operatorname*{arg\,max}_kU_k(P_0)\), with \(|A|\geq2\), and suppose every policy in \(A^c\) is separated below the tied active welfare.  For every representative \(h\in\mathbb R^A\), including its common-shift component, the path \(\bar P_{C,h}=\bar P_{C^{-1/2},h}\) satisfies \(Q^B_{\bar P_0,p}=Q^B_{P_0,p}\), \(dU_k(\bar P_{t,h})/dt|_{t=0}=h_k\), and
\[
\log\frac{d(Q^B_{\bar P_{C,h},p})^{\otimes C}}{d(Q^B_{P_0,p})^{\otimes C}}
=h^{\prime}\Delta_C^B-\frac12h^{\prime}I_Bh+o_{(Q^B_{P_0,p})^{\otimes C}}(1),
\qquad \Delta_C^B\Rightarrow N(0,I_B),
\]
with \(\dot\ell_k^B\in L^2_0(Q^B_{P_0,p})\) and \(I_B=\operatorname{diag}(q_k/\tau_k^2:k\in A)\).  Under \(\bar P_{C,h}\),
\[
\sqrt C\{\widetilde U_{C,A}-U_A(P_0)\}\Rightarrow
N\{h,\Sigma_{B,A}\}.
\]
For every measurable randomized rule sequence \(\delta_C\) and every \(M<\infty\),
\[
\liminf_{C\to\infty}\sup_{h\in\mathbb R^A:\ \lVert[h]\rVert_A\leq M}
\sqrt C\,\mathbb E_{(Q^B_{\bar P_{C,h},p})^{\otimes C}}
\left[\max_{k\in A}U_k(\bar P_{C,h})-U_{\delta_C}(\bar P_{C,h})\right]
\geq G_{A,M}(\tau_A^2,q_A).
\]
Moreover \(G_{A,M}\uparrow G_A\) as \(M\to\infty\).  The same lower bounds hold for rules observing the full Bernoulli experiment by nuisance deletion.

defs.def:gaussian-face-game:
Fix \(a_0=\min A\), let \(D_A\) have rows \(e_k^{\prime}-e_{a_0}^{\prime}\), \(k\in A\setminus\{a_0\}\), and put \(H_A=\mathbb R^A/\operatorname{span}\{\mathbf 1_A\}\) and \(\lVert[h]\rVert_A=\lVert D_Ah\rVert_2\).  For positive \(v_A,r_A\), let \(\Sigma(v_A,r_A)=\operatorname{diag}(v_k/r_k:k\in A)\) and \(\Omega_A=D_A\Sigma(v_A,r_A)D_A^{\prime}\), and define
\[
G_A(v_A,r_A)=\inf_{\delta}\sup_{h\in\mathbb R^A}\mathbb E_h\!\left[\max_{k\in A}h_k-h_{\delta(X)}\right],\qquad X\mid h\sim N\{h,\Sigma(v_A,r_A)\},
\]
where the infimum is over all measurable randomized selectors.  Equivalently the infimum is over location-invariant selectors \(\delta(x+c\mathbf 1_A)=\delta(x)\), hence over selectors based on \(D_AX\sim N(D_Ah,\Omega_A)\).  For \(M<\infty\), \(G_{A,M}(v_A,r_A)\) is the same invariant-selector game with \(\lVert[h]\rVert_A\leq M\).  On \([0,\infty)^A\), define \(G_A\) at a boundary rate as the lower-semicontinuous closure \(\liminf_{r'\to r,\ r'>0}G_A(v_A,r')\).
defs.def:least-favourable-path: Set \(\bar P_0=\bigotimes_{z\in\mathcal Z_n}P_{0,z}\).  For every representative \(h=(h_k)_{k\in A}\in\mathbb R^A\), including every common-shift direction \(h+c\mathbf 1_A\), keep all nontarget marginals fixed and, for \(z\in\mathcal S_k\) with \(k\in A\), set \(dP_{t,h,z}/dP_{0,z}(y)=\exp\{t h_k(W(y)-\mu_z)/\tau_k^2-\Lambda_{z,k}(t h_k/\tau_k^2)\}\).  Define \(\bar P_{t,h}=\bigotimes_{z\in\mathcal Z_n}P_{t,h,z}\) and \(\bar P_{C,h}=\bar P_{C^{-1/2},h}\).  The decision-relevant coordinate of \(h\) is its class \([h]\in H_A=\mathbb R^A/\operatorname{span}\{\mathbf 1_A\}\), but the statistical path retains the common-shift nuisance rather than fixing a representative.
defs.def:observed-law-kernels: In regime \(\mathsf B(p)\), \(Q^B_{P,p}=P R_{B,p}\) and the sample law is \((Q^B_{P,p})^{\otimes C}\). In regime \(\mathsf{CR}(\alpha)\), \(Q^{CR}_{P,C_C}=P^{\otimes C}R^{CR}_{C_C}\), equivalently the conditional product of stratum-specific observed laws given the randomized fixed-count label vector.
